subject: Re: IMP status: decision - retrieval prototype goes ahead on MoE-B
body:
All,

Wrapping up ahead of the July 20 memo. The Vulcan week was bumpier than hoped - we lost roughly a day and a half at the start to allocation churn on the cluster, so the MoE-L run went out with the reduced-token-budget fallback. Even so: scaling held, with the L-scale checkpoint adding +2.1 cross-modal recall@10 over MoE-B on the internal set.

Decisions:
1. The multimodal retrieval prototype for Q3 builds on IMP-MoE-B - reproducible, well-characterized, cheap to serve. The L-scale result goes in the memo as scaling evidence, not as the serving target.
2. AGD schedule sensitivity gets its own section; anyone scaling this further needs Csilla's ablation table first.
3. Jorge writes up the allocation-churn incident for Ines's team - if we book full-week reservations we need them to actually start on day one.

Good recovery under compute pressure. Memo draft to me by the 17th please.

Anders
